desc: BMW will introduce an M Performance Track Kit for the BMW M2 from July 2026, targeting owners who frequently participate in track days but require road legality.

title: KickNation Sports secures Chelsea, West Ham trials for Ghanaian youngsters
desc: Wunna Haruna, son of Education Minister Haruna Iddrisu and Chief Executive Officer of KickNation Sports Agency, has successfully facilitated trial opportunities in the United Kingdom for two promising Ghanaian players under his management.

desc: The Kuwait ministry of defense says several United States military aircraft crashed this morning in the Middle Eastern country.

title: Farmers won’t be forced to adopt GM maize
desc: Farmers in the Country will not be forced to adopt genetically modified maize once commercialised instead it will be entirely voluntary; a seed breeder expert has told a Kisumu Court.

title: Over 100,000 Israelis stranded abroad
desc: Israeli airlines will begin rescue flights when Ben Gurion airport reopens. Meanwhile Arkia is operating flights from Taba to and from Europe.

title: Hidden oceans on icy moons may be boiling beneath the surface
desc: Icy moons circling the outer planets may be far more dynamic—and explosive—than they appear. New research suggests that when heat from tidal forces melts their ice shells from below, the sudden drop in pressure could cause hidden oceans to boil beneath the surface. On smaller moons like Enceladus, Mimas, and Miranda, this process may help explain strange features such as Enceladus’ tiger stripes and Miranda’s towering cliffs.
